sessionStart.command: sh -c 'd=$(pwd -P); w=$(cd "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-/nonexistent-umc}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); while [ "$w" != "${w%/}" ]; do w=${w%/}; done; p=; case "$d/" in "$w"/*) ;; *) p="$d/scripts/umc-session.sh" ;; esac; if [ -n "$p" ] && [ ! -h "$p" ] && [ -f "$p" ]; then exec sh "$p"; fi; echo {}'
